description: When a provider cancellation intent is held with process_fate=identity_ambiguous, ManualProcessIdentityCheckBanner appears with title 'Process identity needs review', body copy, and disabled automatic retry.
assertions: ManualProcessIdentityCheckBanner component appears in the view hierarchy for provider-session detail and any run/stage surface containing the held provider
banner displays title: 'Process identity needs review'
banner displays body: 'Forge could not prove this provider process is still the same process that was cancelled. Automatic retry is paused until you verify the process identity.'
automatic retry is disabled with no spinner and no countdown: 'Automatic retry paused: process identity is ambiguous.'
banner persists until backend readback moves intent_state away from held or process_fate away from identity_ambiguous
banner does not auto-dismiss without operator action or backend state change
VoiceOver announces title, provider display name, reason, and focused action
